textRuns.value: Curves: the share of each cohort of 36-month loans that had defaulted by each month on book. The Count / Dollar buttons switch between share of loans and share of dollars. Pick a metric above the table at the bottom to change what it shows. Bottom right: the same cohort curve rebuilt in DAX per issue year, and the loan-lifecycle funnel. Default, loss and ROI figures use matured loans only (the full term has ended), so outcomes are final; loans issued from 2016 are mostly still running.
